components.purpose: Model bid-ask cost applied to fill price.
components.current_implementation: Production: fixed 0.30 points (PaperBroker). Phase30A: session/volatility/liquidity/news multipliers on base spread.
hidden_assumptions: Exit uses same fixed spread default 0.30
XAUUSD spread in points not pips
components.real_world_behaviour: XAUUSD spread varies 0.20–1.50+ by session; widens 3–10× on news; broker markup changes intraday.
components.possible_optimism: Fixed 0.30 below peak but may match overlap median
components.possible_pessimism: Phase30A normal scenario may over-penalize if base 0.30 already conservative

expected_impact.profit_factor: HIGH — PF 1.211→1.0486 (-0.162) normal sim; high_spread stress PF=0.7536; breaking at 1.5× multiplier (sample n=120)
expected_impact.drawdown: HIGH — DD 24.3%→38.5% under normal simulated execution (phase30a performance_comparison)

components.purpose: Model adverse/favourable price movement between decision and fill.
components.current_implementation: Production: fixed +0.10 points on entry (PaperBroker). Live: measured post-fill vs requested. Phase30A: probabilistic ± magnitude from ATR/liquidity/lot.
hidden_assumptions: Slippage only on entry in paper
Slippage independent of order size in production
Live deviation max 20 points always sufficient
components.real_world_behaviour: Slippage fat-tailed during volatility; market orders slip more than limits; partial fills slip differently.
components.possible_bias: Mixed — paper hides slippage in journal; simulator may over-slippage in calm regimes
components.possible_optimism: 0.10 points small for XAUUSD M5 scalping
components.possible_pessimism: Flash-crash slippage fat tails not fully captured

expected_impact.profit_factor: MEDIUM — slippage multiplier breaking point 7.0× (sample); less dominant than spread
expected_impact.drawdown: MEDIUM — contributes to tail losses in high_slippage stress
expected_impact.expectancy: MEDIUM — secondary to spread in Phase30A sweeps

components.purpose: Adjust execution cost by FX session liquidity cycle.
components.current_implementation: Phase30A only: Asian 1.35×, London 1.0×, Overlap 0.85×, NY 0.95×. Not in production.
hidden_assumptions: Hour UTC maps cleanly to session
Same multipliers for entry and exit
components.real_world_behaviour: London/NY overlap tightest; Asian widest for gold; Sunday open special.
components.possible_optimism: N/A — not applied in live/paper path
components.possible_pessimism: Simulator may under-widen Asian session vs real ECN

expected_impact.profit_factor: MEDIUM — embedded in normal sim PF degradation

components.purpose: Model decision-to-fill time across stack components.
components.current_implementation: Phase30A: Gaussian components (decision/python/mt5/broker/network/execution) summed; NOT applied to price path.
hidden_assumptions: Latency does not move price in replay
ML pipeline 500ms timeout separate from execution latency

components.possible_optimism: Total latency ~80ms mean may be realistic for co-located VPS
components.possible_pessimism: Missing price drift makes latency look free

components.purpose: Estimate available depth for requested lot size.
